audit.whatIsWrong: Two of Aurora's abilities were called by names she does not have: 'Passage (E)' — really The Weirding — and 'Between Above and Below (R)' — really Between Worlds, which appeared in four fields. The E was also described as a gap-closer; Riot's text says she 'hops backward to safety' after casting it.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/aurora.json slot names and E text; packet.defects flags that the matchup 'never names any of Aurora's abilities'.
audit.corrected: Her reach is Twofold Hex at 900 and Across the Veil at 700; The Weirding moves her AWAY from you, so punishing 'her dash into your zone' was advice for a mechanic that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: The lane clock was named but never numbered, and the reason the hop is dangerous — she turns INVISIBLE on landing — was only implied.
audit.why: Aurora W: 22/21/20/19/18, range 700, text 'entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible'.
audit.corrected: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 and 18s at rank 5; while it is down she has no way to reach you and no way to disappear.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora. whys[3] also justified its Levels 4-5 'Skill' row by talking about level 6 onward.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[0..6]; Between Worlds arrives at 6 on a 140s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Hwei, 4-5 skill, then Aurora from 6 as Between Worlds and a first item take over.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Abjuration was absent from the matchup entirely — her spirits heal her, so a chip-poke gameplan without Grievous Wounds gives the health straight back.
audit.why: Aurora P heal flag and text 'Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.'
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing is now in breakdown.mid and breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: 24 MISGENDER hits, two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets and a cooldowns field with no digit.
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js marks aurora female; lintFindings names the bleed fields and the cooldown field.
audit.corrected: All fixed; cooldowns now carries 22s, 15s and 140s.

notes: Two fabricated ability names killed: 'Passage (E)' is really The Weirding, and 'Between Above and Below (R)' — used in four fields — is really Between Worlds. This matches packet.defects, which reported the matchup never names any of Aurora's abilities. A mechanical error came with them: The Weirding was described as her way to 'close distance', and spikes[0] told the reader to punish 'every dash attempt into your combo zone'. Riot's text is that she 'hops backward to safety' after the blast — the E moves her AWAY. Her actual reach is Twofold Hex at 900 and Across the Veil at 700, and the hop turns her INVISIBLE on landing, which is the real reason it is the lane's clock. Level chart: all seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora; I moved the full layer onto the already-correct content layer, so no paired win[N] edit was needed, and phases[3] already matched. I also re-grounded whys[3], which justified a Levels 4-5 'Skill' row by describing level 6 onward. The _missing interaction — Spirit Abjuration healing her through chip poke — is now in breakdown.mid and breakdown.feeding with the anti-heal call. Ratings untouched.
